changes.title: fix(tsplib): support all nine EDGE_WEIGHT_FORMAT layouts, not three

commit.message:
task(tsplib): record support for all nine EDGE_WEIGHT_FORMAT layouts

The parser read three of nine; si175/si535/si1032 (UPPER_DIAG_ROW) were
unreadable, which is why the bench tier substitutes gr120 for si175. Records the
72-run verification that re-encoded eight instances with real optimal tours into
every layout and scored their tour at the published optimum.
